# Markdeep renderer

`markdeep2.min.cjs` is Markdeep 2.01, downloaded from
https://morgan3d.github.io/markdeep/2/latest/markdeep2.min.js on 2026-11-11.
The extension is changed to `.cjs` for explicit Node.js CommonJS loading.
Its original copyright/license header is retained. See the upstream project:
https://casual-effects.com/markdeep/ and https://github.com/morgan3d/markdeep.

This copy is committed so builds do not change when upstream `latest` changes.
MathJax is installed separately, pinned by package.json and package-lock.json.
